description: An animated numeric stat — counts from fromValue (default 0) up to content.value on a single spring, with an optional label above or below. The canonical 'big number' primitive for KPIs, metrics, and callout figures.

value.description: Target value the counter animates to

fromValue.description: Starting value for the count-up; defaults to 0

label.description: Optional caption rendered above/below the number (see styleOverride.labelPosition)

typography.description: typography token for the number (fontFamily/weight/color; size derives fontSize)

easing.description: easing token for the count-up spring

valueFill.description: raw hex override for the number color; falls back to typography's resolved color

labelFill.description: raw hex override for the label color; falls back to labelTypography's resolved color

canvasFill.description: raw hex for an optional background card; 'transparent' for none

decimals.description: fixed decimal places on the formatted number

prefix.description: raw string prepended to the formatted number, e.g. '$'

suffix.description: raw string appended to the formatted number, e.g. '%' or ' users'
